description: Source code for MoonshotChatConfig class that customizes and extends OpenAIGPTConfig for Moonshot AI's chat completion API, including message transformation, URL construction, parameter support, and request handling.

classes.name: MoonshotChatConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for Moonshot AI's chat API, extending OpenAIGPTConfig with custom message handling, URL generation, parameter support, and request transformation.

methods.name: _transform_messages
methods.description: Transforms messages, converting list content to string as Moonshot AI does not support list format.

methods.name: _get_openai_compatible_provider_info
methods.description: Retrieves API base URL and API key, using secrets if not provided.

methods.name: get_complete_url
methods.description: Constructs the full API URL for chat completions, appending endpoint if necessary.

methods.name: get_supported_openai_params
methods.description: Returns supported OpenAI parameters for Moonshot AI, excluding unsupported ones based on model.

methods.name: map_openai_params
methods.description: Maps OpenAI parameters to Moonshot AI parameters, applying specific limitations and adjustments.

methods.name: transform_request
methods.description: Prepares and transforms the request payload, adding required messages if 'tool_choice' is needed.

methods.name: _add_tool_choice_required_message
methods.description: Adds a message prompting the user to select a tool when 'tool_choice' is required.
